verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken decorative rules. The lines meant to frame LAVANDER start at its centre and run off to the right edge of the panel, and the rules beside HOMEMADE LOTION are pulled apart: the left one cuts across a lavender sprig and the right one floats by itself. In both, the text block is tiny for the wide canvas and SKINCARE is almost unreadable. The two candidates are nearly pixel-identical; B is only shifted a few pixels to the right.
